extraction_warnings: This paper reports only aggregate/group-level data for the human cohort (n=41 control, 56 pHTN, 99 HTN); no individual subject_id or sample_id values are given in the provided text, so these required fields are 'not_reported'.
Age, sex distribution, and BMI values are referenced only via supplementary Table S1, which is not included in the provided text, so exact values could not be extracted.
The 'control' and 'disease' fields required a dict-style value to represent subgroup-level heterogeneity (control/pHTN/HTN); downstream harmonization should map these to controlled vocabularies.

A separate mouse fecal-transplant experiment and an independent validation cohort (Qin et al. diabetes study, n=6) exist in the paper but were not used to populate the main human subject/sample fields, since the schema fields pertain to the primary human cohort description.
No NCBI/SRA accession numbers were found in the provided text.
Batch 1 subgroups ['Healthy control', 'Pre-hypertension (pHTN)', 'Hypertension (HTN)'] differ from batch 0 ['control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.

Paper is a human cohort + mouse FMT microbiome study of hypertension, not an oncology/immunotherapy trial; many oncology-specific schema fields (ORR, PFS, RECIST, tumor staging, ECOG, tumor size) are not applicable and were marked not_reported.
Neonatal and OB/GYN fields are not applicable to this adult hypertension cohort and were marked not_reported.
Smoker status was inferred from an exclusion criterion (smokers excluded) rather than explicitly labeled per participant; confidence lowered accordingly.
Treatment field marked not_reported because patients were explicitly treatment-naive (pre-antihypertensive treatment) and specific drugs were confirmed NOT used.
FMT donor/recipient details (specific IDs) are only in supplementary Table S17, not available in provided text.

Biomarker value ranges reflect classification thresholds used to define control/pHTN/HTN groups, not individual patient measured values; treated as subgroup-level derived/directly stated data from Methods.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.
study_name field required by schema but no canonical identifier found in text; returned not_reported.
pmid field required-adjacent but not explicitly stated in the provided paper text (only DOI given); returned not_reported despite paper_id metadata being 28143587.

host_species enum only supports a single value, but the study involves both human participants and germ-free mice (FMT experiment); reported 'Human' as primary with mouse experiment detailed in by_subgroup and notes.

sequencing_platform for the main human metagenomic cohort is only described generically as 'Illumina platform' without model specificity; the more specific 'Illumina HiSeq' designation comes from the mouse 16S rRNA sequencing methods section.
